steps.content: The living room windows are, as always, covered with blackout curtains. The computer screen flickers with blue and green lights, casting reflections on the fish tank. As the fish swims gracefully, the reflections ripple in circles.
You sit in front of the computer, elbows on the table, fingers steepled in front of your nose as your eyes remain fixed on the flickering screen.

<color=#fb9259>You</color>: Are you sure he's the client? She's never mentioned him before.

<color=#fb9259>User_W555</color>: Yes, yes! It's him! Woohoo, we won!!!

On the dark side of the internet, deep within the shadows of the city, a group of special agents from the 9th Agency, Public Security Bureau and MBCC are cheerfully celebrating their success in advance with anonymous accounts and encrypted messages.

[The following messages are decrypted] User_W555: It got much easier after we figured out the Syndicate gangs are behind the trouble. We just had to track down those who have some money, and guess who have been keeping their eyes on the new mines like hawks? User_Y342: These attacks happened too close to one another. Someone must be pulling the strings behind the scenes. User_9x9: Hehe, want to know how our old friends from the Underground are doing? User_Y342: Just as we expected, a lot of highly modified Sinners are involved. Guess we'll have some big troubles in the future. User_W555: Let's celebrate first! We finally found Chief after all this time, don't be such a downer!

<color=#fb9259>You</color>: Seems like everyone's efficiency has improved a lot after I was kidnapped.
<color=#fb9259>You</color>: Not having to worry about me has really increased your case-solving speed.

<color=#fb9259>User_W555</color>: Don't say that, Chief! Adjutant Nightingale is here, and she's been working hard to get you back ASAP. She is going to talk your ears off when you're back after you said that. っ°Д°;)っ

<color=#fb9259>User_N049</color>: ...

<color=#fb9259>User_N049</color>: This operation wouldn't have been so smooth without the first-hand intel from the dark web. You even found your own location by yourself, you're the one who's been putting in the most work, Chief.
<color=#fb9259>User_N049</color>: But please don't put yourself in such danger in the future.

<color=#fb9259>You</color>: It was nothing. I just paid the electricity bill and surfed the net a little. You guys are here for me anyway, haha.
<color=#fb9259>User_W555</color>: AHHH, Chief, stop that already!っ°Д°;)っ

<color=#fb9259>User_Y342</color>: The rescue team has located you with the power supply records. We're getting ready to arrest the Sinner. Just give us the order, and we'll spring into action.
<color=#fb9259>User_Y342</color>: You've been fighting on your own for so long, Chief. Hang in there, we will rescue you soon.

<color=#fb9259>You</color>: ...No. There's no need to confront this Sinner.
<color=#fb9259>You</color>: We're after the rats hiding behind DisMyth and the trap is set, making a scene here might just scare them off.
<color=#fb9259>You</color>: I'll deal with Angell and try to bring her back to the Bureau peacefully.

<color=#fb9259>User_Y342</color>: ...Chief, she's a DisMyth hitman who has been threatening your life.

<color=#fb9259>You</color>: It would be even more dangerous to confront her. You all know what I've been doing. Trust me, my method is more likely to work.
<color=#fb9259>You</color>: If it would make you worry less, you can stay about a kilometer away and cover me from there.

<color=#fb9259>You</color>: ...I've seen the dark side of the city, and it's more dangerous than I imagined. But fortunately, I met a hitman with a good heart, and I have you guys, who never gave up on rescuing me.
<color=#fb9259>You</color>: Without you all, I might have walked straight into my grave from the start.

<color=#fb9259>You</color>: Thanks to you, I have the courage to take the risk. I believe in you all, and I want to believe in her too.


<color=#fb9259>Others</color>: Chief...
Seeing the mushy talk has worked, you quickly seize the chance to finalize the operation.

<color=#fb9259>You</color>: Alright, let's not waste time here. Once everything is over, we'll have a proper celebration back at the Bureau.

<color=#fb9259>You</color>: We're entering the final phase of the operation. You guys take care of the clients, I'll deal with this Top Hitman.

<color=#fb9259>User_N049</color>: ...Copy that.
<color=#fb9259>User_W555</color>: Copy that!!(｡・ω・｡) 
<color=#fb9259>User_Y342</color>: Copy that!
<color=#fb9259>User_9x9</color>: Copy that.
It's done. Now it's time to think about your plan—how to persuade her and minimize risks. You are lost in thought, and eventually the screen in front of you dims and goes into sleep mode.

The black screen reflects your face and the small room behind you. This apartment has witnessed an oddly peaceful time shared by two people on opposite sides. But soon, it'll end, as everyone must eventually return to where they belong.
Maybe once this is over, the two of you could start anew together, but there's just something...
...that makes you hesitate slightly as you place the final period on this chapter.
